bills.title: Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (International Production Orders) Bill 2020

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2021-06-24.187.1) to the usual [second reading motion](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) "*that the bill be read a second time*", which is parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill.
